name: QUEEN Tower

whyInvest.title: Class-A Office Space
whyInvest.description: A modern office tower built to the top specification in its market, aimed at tenants who pay for quality space, amenities and location.

whyInvest.title: Retail Podium Income
whyInvest.description: Ground-floor shops and restaurants add a second stream of rent alongside the office floors, so income doesn't depend on one type of tenant.

whyInvest.title: Contracted Rental Income
whyInvest.description: Rent comes from long-term leases with financial, legal and technology firms. Distributions are paid onchain to token holders in proportion to their holdings.

whyInvest.title: Central Business District Address
whyInvest.description: Office space in Midtown is limited and close to transit, services and talent, which supports long-term tenant demand.

location: QUEEN Tower is in Midtown Manhattan, a short walk from Grand Central Terminal and Bryant Park. Midtown is one of the largest office markets in the world, and newer Class-A buildings continue to attract tenants upgrading from older stock.

name: Mars One

whyInvest.title: Specialist Aerospace Facility
whyInvest.description: An R&D campus built for aerospace work, a niche property type with few comparable sites.

whyInvest.title: Long-Term Tenants
whyInvest.description: Labs, test bays and launch-support facilities are expensive to relocate, so tenants typically sign long leases and renew.

whyInvest.title: Dedicated Logistics Pad
whyInvest.description: The on-site pad handles heavy cargo and launch-support equipment that general industrial property can't accommodate.

whyInvest.title: Growing Space Economy
whyInvest.description: Commercial launch and satellite activity has grown sharply over the past decade, raising demand for purpose-built aerospace facilities.

location: Mars One is in Titusville, Florida, on the Space Coast, minutes from Kennedy Space Center and Cape Canaveral. The area is home to a dense cluster of launch providers, satellite manufacturers and aerospace suppliers.

name: OCEAN

whyInvest.title: Hotel + Retail Mix
whyInvest.description: Combines hotel income with marina-side retail, so returns come from both room revenue and shop leases.

whyInvest.title: Waterfront Scarcity
whyInvest.description: Coastal and marina-front land is limited and hard to get approved for new building, which protects the value of existing waterfront property.

whyInvest.title: Tourism-Driven Demand
whyInvest.description: Visitors to the marina and nearby beaches drive both hotel occupancy and retail footfall.

whyInvest.title: Operating Upside
whyInvest.description: Hotel income moves with nightly room rates, so strong management can grow revenue faster than fixed leases can. It can also fall faster in a downturn.

location: OCEAN sits on the waterfront in Miami Beach, Florida, next to the Miami Beach Marina at South Pointe. Peak season runs December through April, when winter visitors and boat-show traffic fill hotels and restaurants.

name: North Texas Bitcoin Miners

whyInvest.title: Industrial-Scale Hashrate
whyInvest.description: 15,000 Antminer S19 XP units, about 2.1 EH/s and roughly 45 MW at full capacity, mining bitcoin around the clock.

whyInvest.title: Renewable Power
whyInvest.description: Runs on renewable-sourced power. Energy is the biggest cost in mining, so cheaper and cleaner power improves margins and meets institutional ESG requirements.

whyInvest.title: Built-In Resilience
whyInvest.description: Backup power and Starlink satellite internet keep machines running through grid or local network outages.

whyInvest.title: Productive Bitcoin Exposure
whyInvest.description: Returns follow bitcoin's price and network difficulty, giving exposure through an income-producing asset rather than holding the coin. Revenue can fall sharply if the price drops or difficulty rises.

location: The facility is about an hour northwest of Dallas–Fort Worth, on the ERCOT grid. Texas offers below-average industrial power prices, large wind and solar capacity, and demand-response programmes that pay miners to power down during peak grid demand.

name: King's Gold

whyInvest.title: Allocated Physical Gold
whyInvest.description: Each token is backed by specific, allocated bars held in a vault, not a paper claim on a shared pool.

whyInvest.title: Good Delivery Standard
whyInvest.description: Bars meet the LBMA Good Delivery standard, the purity and weight benchmark accepted by the world's major gold markets.

whyInvest.title: Onchain Proof of Reserve
whyInvest.description: Vault holdings are verified onchain on Mavryk and independently audited, so anyone can check that tokens in circulation match the gold in storage.

whyInvest.title: Long-Term Store of Value
whyInvest.description: Gold has preserved wealth for centuries and has often held its value during inflation and market stress.

location: The gold comes from the Ashanti region of Ghana, Africa's largest gold producer and one of the world's oldest gold-mining areas. Bars are refined in Switzerland and held in a fully insured, high-security vault in Zurich.

name: Anthropic

whyInvest.title: Frontier AI Developer
whyInvest.description: Anthropic builds the Claude family of AI models, used by businesses and developers through its API, apps and major cloud platforms.

whyInvest.title: Pre-IPO Access
whyInvest.description: Economic exposure to a private company, a stage usually open only to venture funds and large institutions.

whyInvest.title: SPV Structure
whyInvest.description: Tokens represent an interest in a special purpose vehicle that holds Anthropic shares. Token holders don't own shares directly, and a future listing is not guaranteed.

whyInvest.title: Fractional Entry
whyInvest.description: Invest small amounts instead of the six-figure minimums typical of private-company secondaries.

location: Anthropic is headquartered in San Francisco, California. The SPV is a Delaware limited liability company managed by a regulated fund administrator.

name: Kraken

whyInvest.title: Established Exchange
whyInvest.description: Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the longest-running crypto exchanges, serving retail and institutional clients worldwide.

whyInvest.title: Proof-of-Reserves Track Record
whyInvest.description: Kraken was an early adopter of proof-of-reserves audits, letting clients verify that balances are fully backed.

whyInvest.title: Multiple Business Lines
whyInvest.description: Revenue comes from spot trading, derivatives and other services rather than a single product.

whyInvest.title: Pre-IPO Access via SPV
whyInvest.description: Tokens represent an interest in an SPV holding shares of Payward, Inc., Kraken's parent company. Token holders don't own shares directly, and a future listing is not guaranteed.

location: Kraken was founded in San Francisco and operates as a remote-first company serving clients around the world. The SPV is a Delaware limited liability company.

name: Vanguard S&P 500 ETF

whyInvest.title: Broad US Market Exposure
whyInvest.description: One token tracks the S&P 500, spreading your investment across about 500 of the largest US companies in every major sector.

whyInvest.title: Low Cost
whyInvest.description: The underlying fund charges a 0.03% annual expense ratio, among the lowest in the industry. Equiteez platform fees apply separately.

whyInvest.title: Quarterly Dividends
whyInvest.description: The fund pays dividends each quarter, passed through to token holders onchain, net of fees and withholding tax.

whyInvest.title: Trade Beyond Market Hours
whyInvest.description: Tokens trade 24/7 on Equiteez, while the ETF itself trades only during US market hours. Off-hours prices may differ from the fund's value.

location: VOO is issued by Vanguard, headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania, and listed on NYSE Arca. It holds US large-cap companies. The ETF shares backing each token are held by a regulated US custodian.

name: Realty Income Corporation

whyInvest.title: Monthly Dividends
whyInvest.description: Realty Income pays dividends every month and is an S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrat, with 25+ consecutive years of dividend increases.

whyInvest.title: Net-Lease Model
whyInvest.description: Tenants cover most property taxes, insurance and maintenance, making rental income more predictable.

whyInvest.title: Diversified Portfolio
whyInvest.description: 15,000+ commercial properties leased to tenants across retail, industrial and other sectors.

whyInvest.title: Investment-Grade Balance Sheet
whyInvest.description: Investment-grade credit ratings keep borrowing costs down and support the dividend through market cycles.

location: Realty Income is headquartered in San Diego, California, and listed on the NYSE (ticker: O). Its properties span all 50 US states, the UK and several other European countries.

name: US Treasury Bill

whyInvest.title: Backed by the US Government
whyInvest.description: T-bills are short-term debt issued by the US Treasury and widely regarded as one of the lowest-risk assets available.

whyInvest.title: Daily Yield
whyInvest.description: Yield accrues daily and is reflected in the token price.

whyInvest.title: Low Volatility
whyInvest.description: Maturities under one year keep price moves small, making it a practical place to hold cash between trades.

whyInvest.title: Onchain Liquidity
whyInvest.description: Settles instantly and transfers 24/7 on Mavryk, unlike T-bills bought through a traditional broker.

location: The underlying T-bills are issued by the US Department of the Treasury and held by a qualified US custodian. The issuing vehicle is a dedicated fund that holds only T-bills and cash.
